item.title: Tracks East - USA-Russia A New Cold War? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.11.2023)
item.description:
Has Russia's invasion of Ukraine plunged the world back into the Cold War? And what if Russia's attack on its neighbour was actually aimed at the United States? Jean-Michel Scherbak travels to New York for Tracks East to meet Ukrainian and Russian communities there.
From 09.11.2023 11:34

item.title: #AMINORMAL (5/8) - How to Make Friends With Food (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (31.01.2022)
item.description:
Do you sometimes secretly eat so much that your stomach hurts? These interviews show that you are not alone. And if a lot of people do that, it's kind of normal, isn't it? The Handbook of Mental Disorders (DSM) sees it differently. Binge eating is a disorder, and it's the most common eating disorder in the US!
From 31.01.2022 14:40

item.title: Tracks East - Blackout (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.01.2023)
item.description:
In Kyiv's Closer Club, Ukrainians are trying to preserve a bit of normality in wartime. In the past, dance fans from across Europe made the pilgrimage to the Ukrainian capital's legendary techno nights. Every December, the Black Factory Night takes place, and this winter is no different. If there’s a blackout, they’re got generators at the ready.
From 10.01.2023 05:00

item.title: Tracks East - Iranian Women Resist (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (15.09.2023)
item.description:
In September 2022 the death of Mahsa Amini in police custody set off nationwide protests in Iran. One year on from this civil unrest, Tracks East meets the ultra-connected younger generation who demonstrate their opposition to the government through art and music.
From 15.09.2023 15:14

item.title: Tracks East - Humour as a Weapon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.12.2022)
item.description:
When bombs are raining down all around, when freedom of expression is removed, does this make you laugh? Tracks East looks at how humour is used as a weapon in testing times in Belarus, Ukraine and Bulgaria. (And how dictators don’t have a very developed sense of humour.)
From 13.12.2022 17:27

item.title: Tracks East - Myth, Religion and War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (31.12.2022)
item.description:
Religion has played a major role in the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Russian Orthodox Patriarch Kirill supports the war - Chechen leader Ramzan Kadyrov is sending Muslim soldiers to Ukraine in a "holy war". We meet the Ukrainian muslim bloggers. Artist Masha Maroz takes us on a journey through the ancestral rites of Polesia and Mihaela Drăgan invokes Roma superstitions about witches.
From 31.12.2022 05:00

item.title: #AMINORMAL (4/8) - How to Survive Your Period (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
The womb may create life, but it can also make life pretty miserable. The women interviewed here tell us how they experience bad mood swings before menstruation. This is normal unless you read the DSM: after “premenstrual syndrome”, the latest edition establishes a more severe disorder, known as premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD).
From 30.01.2022 12:08

item.title: Tracks East - Hierarchies – Who’s in Charge? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.01.2023)
item.description:
Addressing the issue of exploitation and power relations in Eastern Europe and Central Asia, Tracks East focuses on Armenia, Azerbaijan and Russia.
From 24.01.2023 17:22

item.title: Klapping / Emilie Brout & Maxime Marion / Sisto / Ami Yerewolo - Tracks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.12.2021)
item.description:
The art of klapping, where dance meets football.  Also in the programme: Artist couple Emilie Brout and Maxime Marion harvest the internet. Spanish multi-media artist Pascual Sisto talks about his new film ‘John and the Hole’ and Ami Yerewolo raps in Bambara to traditional African music.
From 07.12.2021 15:10

item.title: Tracks East - Moldova Next Generation: Putin's Next Victim? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.04.2023)
item.description:
How are young people in Moldova responding to the Russian threat to their country?DJ Borș returned to Moldova when the war in Ukraine began. Like many in her generation, she feels in a state of limbo because no one knows what tomorrow will bring. With her initiative "Make Borș Not War", she is revitalising the party scene in Chisinau.
From 13.04.2023 15:19

item.title: The Kennedy Dynasty (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.09.2023)
item.description:
The mighty American political dynasty played a major role in twentieth century America. This is the story of nine siblings who lived truly remarkable lives touched by greatness as well as tragedy.
From 07.09.2023 08:00

item.title: Tracks East - Children of War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.02.2023)
item.description:
In war it is often the children who suffer the most. Their stable home lives are destroyed and they have to flee. According to Ukrainian sources, 12,000 Ukrainian children have been taken to Russia, the Kremlin says they have been ‘brought home’.
From 21.02.2023 05:00

item.title: Tracks East - Eurovision: Pop and Politics (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.05.2023)
item.description:
For many, the Eurovision Song Contest is the chance for a Pan-European party. But it is also highly political, especially for countries in Eastern Europe. When Ukrainian group Kalush Orchestra won in 2022, it was a message of European solidarity against Russian aggression.
From 03.05.2023 17:41

item.title: Tracks East - Turkey: The New Generation (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (10.05.2023)
item.description:
A new generation has come of age in Turkey that doesn’t want to live like their parents. On social media, on comedy stages and in rap music a counterculture is flourishing. Filmmaker Ufuk Cam goes to Turkey to uncover the local scene.
From 10.05.2023 17:37

item.title: Tracks Inside (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.07.2023)
item.description:
Psychedelic drugs as a miracle cure for mental health? In Europe and the USA, investors are pouring hug sums into research and psychedelic trips branded as wellness weekends are becoming more common. Tracks investigates the claims and the dangers.
From 20.07.2023 17:08

item.title: It's Yours - The Story of Hip Hop and the Internet (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.10.2021)
item.description:
In the early 2000s, the successes of US hip-hop artists like Lil B, Wiz Khalifa or Tyler The Creator, was thanks to their mastery of the Internet. They broke away from traditional sales models, and the hip-hop community forged its own way into mainstream recognition without the help of music execs.
From 18.10.2021 18:41

item.title: Tracks East - Pacifism: What’s the Point? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.04.2023)
item.description:
Is pacifism still relevant as war rages in Ukraine? What is the point of peaceful demonstrations when the aggressor will stop at nothing? Tracks East gives a voice to the Ukrainian, Belarusian and Russian opposition and peace movements.
From 20.04.2023 17:01

item.title: Tracks East - Pop, Power and Propaganda (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.09.2023)
item.description:
In Russia, the regime has a musical army of pop artists who perform patriotic songs that glorify the Russian people. Some artists criticise the regime and are duly side-lined. What happens when pop music meets propaganda?
From 14.09.2023 16:45

item.title: In-Game Photography - Art of Gaming (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.02.2022)
item.description:
Video game photographer Martin Geisler shows us with examples from “Skyrim”, “the Hunter” and “Squad” that photography within gameplay has become as art form.
From 02.02.2022 08:01

item.title: #AMINORMAL (6/8) - How to Live With a Hoarder (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
Enthusiasts present their collections of stones, Star Wars, dolls, axes and even bones… and their spouses are supposed to just make room! They thought they were normal, except if they were read the diagnosis of the DSM, the bible of mental health, they might recognise themselves. The mania for excessively accumulating objects is qualified as a disorder!
From 30.01.2022 12:16

item.title: Tracks East - The Dead Don't Die: Never Forgetting (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.10.2023)
item.description:
At the front, the war continues, but for Ukrainians, the process of remembering has already begun. How can the country honour its many dead while conflict endures? In this episode, Tracks East looks at the way in which men and women evoke the past and perpetuate its memory.
From 17.10.2023 14:47

item.title: Tracks East - The Polish Paradox (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (29.09.2023)
item.description:
Tracks East finds out how militarisation, migration, and an increasing polarisation within society are affecting the mood in Poland as elections approach.
From 29.09.2023 15:47

item.title: Tracks: Songwriting Special - Pop Music: The Great Recycling Business (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.04.2022)
item.description:
Have you ever wondered why pop songs sometimes sound a little too familiar? Welcome to the world of pop-recycling where borrowing, sampling and interpolation are the order of the day. Featuring interviews with Placebo, Ed Sheeran, Charlie XCX and Lauv.
From 11.04.2022 15:20

item.title: Tracks East - Daily life in Putin's Russia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (26.09.2023)
item.description:
Eighteen months after Russia invaded Ukraine, how is Russian civil society coping with Putin’s dictatorial drift? Tracks East investigates with journalist and debunker of fake news, Masha Borzunova.
From 26.09.2023 16:33

item.title: The Singing Nun - Who Killed the Voice of God? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.10.2023)
item.description:
Sister Smile released her hit single Dominique in 1962, before an appearance on the Ed Sullivan Show catapulted “The Singing Nun” to the top of the US charts. But Sister Smile, real name Jeanne Deckers, became a plaything of the almighty music industry, and the Catholic Church. A closeted gay woman, her life was tragically cut short by suicide. 
From 24.10.2023 13:00

item.title: Tracks East - Love in Wartime (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.03.2023)
item.description:
In Ukraine, long-distance love is the new normal. Indie pop icon Ingret Kostenko had a meteoric rise to fame until the Russian invasion forced her to flee to Germany. The man she loved was a soldier at the front and she went home regularly to see him. This separation is the inspiration for Ingret’s music.
From 21.03.2023 14:25

item.title: Tracks East - Parallel Worlds at War (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (07.11.2023)
item.description:
The children of the Russian elite live out their dreams while their non-elite compatriots are sent to the front in Ukraine, invoking a well-connected parent allows them to escape mobilisation. Exiled Russian journalist Masha Borzunova sheds light on these parallel worlds.
From 07.11.2023 12:04

item.title: Julio Iglesias - Latin Crooner, Global Star (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (01.12.2023)
item.description:
Julio Iglesias is probably the best known Spanish-language singer. From his beginnings in Franco's Spain to his rise to international fame, a portrait of the Spanish singer, who has managed to combine his innate charm with a skilful political neutrality to reach the top.
From 01.12.2023 05:00

item.title: Tracks East - This is my body! (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.06.2023)
item.description:
In many countries, the state wants to control your body: the clothes you wear, your facial hair and for women, even their pregnancies. Tracks East meets Polish journalist and mixed martial-arts fighter Maja Staśko to find out the situation in Poland and the world.
From 13.06.2023 13:20

item.title: Tracks East - The Millennials of the Balkans (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.05.2023)
item.description:
Since the wars that devastated the Balkans in the 1990s, the international community has continued to associate Southeastern Europe with a powder keg. Tracks East has therefore chosen to give a voice to young artists from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Serbia, and Kosovo who strive to portray a different image of this region of the world.
From 30.05.2023 09:52

item.title: Tracks East - Roots! Where Do You Come From? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.06.2023)
item.description:
Who am I and where do I belong? Tracks East brings together artists who are asking themselves the fundamental question of their origins and identity.
From 20.06.2023 11:34

item.title: #AMINORMAL (7/8) - How to Flirt When You're Shy (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.01.2022)
item.description:
They've always been shy and they've struggled with the feeling of a tight throat, blushing, and the deep fear of rejection that makes conversation difficult. Is this type of shy natural and normal, or is it social anxiety as defined in the DSM?
From 30.01.2022 12:20

item.title: Tracks East - Cancel Russia? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.06.2023)
item.description:
Since Russia invaded its neighbour Ukraine, many are demanding cultural institutions not to programme Russian works. Is leaving out Tchaikovsky's "Swan Lake" or Chekhov's "Three Sisters" already a form of cancel culture? 
From 06.06.2023 17:40

item.title: Total Immersion Special - Tracks (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (06.01.2022)
item.description:
A total immersion into the world of sound: Sound engineer Nicolas Becker explains his craft featured in films such as Sound of Metal and La Haine. FUJIIIIIIITA, makes his own instruments to let his audience have new sound experiences. With more than 500 films (and 500,000 photographs), Boris Lehman is the first-person filmmaker par excellence.
From 06.01.2022 16:41

item.title: Sauerland, Germany - Terroir Cuisine (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.11.2023)
item.description:
In autumn, during hunting season, the Gilsbach family cook and eat the game they've killed. Whether as a poached fillet, in ground steak or in consommé, the meat is served with seasonal products, including rosehip compote and other Westphalian delicacies.
From 25.11.2023 05:00

item.title: At the Table in Saxon-Anhalt - Terroir Cuisine (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.11.2023)
item.description:
In the Land of Saxony-Anhalt, agriculture plays a major role in the economy and spring means the return of asparagus to the plates. The Tinneberg family grows this vegetable in the Altmark region, 150 kilometers from Berlin. For them, it is a way of life. 
From 21.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Journey to Armenia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.11.2023)
item.description:
A trip through the small and diverse country of Armenia, nestled in the South Caucasus.
From 05.11.2023 05:00

item.title: GEO Reportage - Winter in Stockholm (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2023)
item.description:
Stockholm and its archipelago are world famous tourist destinations, busy with visitors in the summer months. But in winter things are quiet; Captain Niclas Jornée keeps the islands supplied with his local ferry service. In Stockholm the choir of the Adolf Fredriks Music School prepares for a special St Lucy’s Day concert and the Swedes decorate their city with lights during the season of darkness.....
From 02.12.2023 05:00

item.title: Cape Verde - Sound of Longing (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.10.2023)
item.description:
Journey to the heart of the Cape Verde archipelago where the musical people celebrate carnival and cherish their traditional music, the morna, made world-famous by Cesaria Évora.
From 22.10.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Buffaloes in Laos (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.10.2023)
item.description:
In Laos, water buffaloes are regarded as a ‘savings accounts for a rainy day’". If someone has to go to hospital, if the rice runs out or if a wedding icoming up, a buffalo is sold. But most of them are weak and malnourished. But innovative feed blocks could improve their health.
From 02.10.2023 05:00

item.title: The Old Woman and the Lake (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (16.02.2023)
item.description:
Lyubov, which means love in Russian, is 80 years old and lives alone on the shores of Lake Baikal. She bears witness to this wonder of nature and possesses and unbreakable bond with the world’s deepest lake in Siberia. Her life here is hard, especially in winter, but she would not live anywhere else.
From 16.02.2023 18:14

item.title: Geo Reportage - The Green Lungs of Europe (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (02.12.2023)
item.description:
In Europe, the last primary forests are found almost exclusively in the mountains in the east or south-east of the continent. These virgin forests have never been exploited or cut down, and have remained as they have always been. Few studies have been done on this forests, which are presumably havens of biodiversity. We go on a research trip to the Dinaric Alps in Albania.
From 02.12.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Women Winemakers of Mendoza (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.10.2023)
item.description:
The Argentinian province of Mendoza, at the foot of the Andes, is the country’s largest wine-growing region and where the famous Malbec grape variety is grown. Wine production has always been a man's business in Argentina. However, some women have decided to get involved and join forces to create their own wine. Despite many obstacles, their dream has become a reality.
From 05.10.2023 16:58

item.title: Geo Reportage - Flying Without Wings (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (04.11.2023)
item.description:
Human beings have always dreamed of being able to fly. This dream has come true thanks to the largest wind tunnel in Europe located near Milan. Initially designed for aeronautics and aerospace, these indoor simulators are now open to all. A new sport has emerged thanks to these massive wind tunnels: part athlete, part dancer, and part bird, sportsmen and women have learned to tame the 200km winds .....
From 04.11.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Georgia: Teachers Needed (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.10.2023)
item.description:
Svaneti is one of the most fascinating and remote regions of Georgia. But many mountain residents leave in search of a better life in the cities. Kala, a small village at almost 2,000 meters above sea level, is no exception. The local principal has just 17 pupils enrolled at the school.
From 09.10.2023 11:44

item.title: Kung Fu Nuns of Nepal - Buddhist and Feminist (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.11.2023)
item.description:
Martial arts, spirituality and female emancipation: in a monastery overlooking Kathmandu, a community of nuns is fighting fit and ready to take on all challenges.
From 13.11.2023 17:55

item.title: GEO Reportage - Canada: The Maple Syrup Country (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (25.09.2023)
item.description:
In Quebec, the return of spring marks the beginning of maple syrup season. For Canadians, this sweet nectar is more than a nutrient-rich sugar substitute, it is an essential part of their culture. A staple of many regional recipes, this amber syrup made from the sap of maple trees, is produced mainly in Quebec and It is now one of Canada's leading exports.
From 25.09.2023 05:00

item.title: Pablo Escobar's Hippos - Geo Reportage (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (03.11.2023)
item.description:
Infamous drug baron Pablo Escobar had four hippos flown over from Africa to populate his very own zoo on his private estate in Columbia. After his death in 1993, the hippos escaped and have been colonising local waterways ever since. Conservationists are now waging a war against this invasive species which is harmful to the local ecosystem and highly dangerous to humans.
From 03.11.2023 14:29

item.title: 360° Reportage - Yabusame: Japan's Woman Samurais (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.11.2023)
item.description:
While the legendary samurai warriors have long since disappeared, their art of equestrian archery, known as yabusame, has endured. This traditional sport was for a long time the preserve of men. But under the impetus of a few committed women, it is undergoing a revolution
From 21.11.2023 13:55

item.title: The Inca Grass Bridge of Q'eswachaka (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.01.2023)
item.description:
In Peru, every year, the people who live in remote mountain villages gather to build the Inca bridge of Q'eswachaka, a traditional structure of woven grass, and the last of its kind. This ancestral know-how inherited from the Incas, and the enduring spirit of community, enables the villagers to pull off a stunning feat of engineering, time and again.
From 24.01.2023 10:27

item.title: 360° Reportage - Sulawesi: The Art of Boat Building (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.11.2023)
item.description:
The Sulawesi Pinisi is a highly manoeuvrable cargo sailing vessel. During the Dutch colonial era, it was used to sail between the Indonesian islands, carrying everything from simple goods to precious commodities for export, particularly spices. The art of making these handsome ships was inscribed on the UNESCO list of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2017.
From 21.11.2023 10:53

item.title: Geo Reportage - Dolphin Therapy in Curaçao (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (11.09.2023)
item.description:
Since 2004, the Dutch Caribbean island of Curaçao has been home to a dolphin therapy centre. Five dolphins help patients, young and old, to regain a taste for life. However, the effectiveness and seriousness of this treatment is criticised by some in the scientific community.
From 11.09.2023 05:00

item.title: 360° Reportage - Maine, USA: Lobster Fishing or Whale Protection? (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.10.2023)
item.description:
Maine is famous for its lobsters which are a major source of income for the local fishing industry and the restaurant trade. However, lobster traps are a major hazard for whales, which regularly get caught in their ropes. How can a vital local tradition coexist with an endangered species?
From 23.10.2023 10:38

item.title: 360° Reportage - Tibetan Medicine - The Heart of Healing (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (13.11.2023)
item.description:
Bringing harmony to body, mind and soul - this is the philosophy behind Tibetan medicine. Traditional medicine has developed over centuries in the remote Himalayan region and is closely linked to Tibetan Buddhism. 360° Reportage seeks out one of the Dalai Lama's personal physicians in Dharamsala in the north of India to learn more.
From 13.11.2023 17:36

item.title: The Cevennes - The Hidden South of France (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (05.11.2023)
item.description:
A journey into a unique and little-known landscape in the south of France: The Cevennes National Park, founded in 1970, is one of the largest in the country with high plateaus, deep gorges and extensive forests.
From 05.11.2023 05:00

item.title: The Humboldt Current - From Peru to the Galapagos Islands (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.11.2023)
item.description:
The Humboldt current flows from the cold Antarctic up the South American coast to the equator. On the barren coast of Peru lies the Punta San Juan nature reserve where the largest population of guano cormorants in the world lives. Further north at the equator, swarms of giant manta rays glide through the sea and a female blue whale drifts leisurely west to reach the Galapagos Islands. Over million.....
From 14.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Puma – The New Beast of Gévaudan (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (24.11.2023)
item.description:
For five years now, rumours have been flying in the rural French region of Gevaudan. Locals have caught sight of a phantom beast and heard its calls at night in the forest. Could a puma be living in the French wilderness?
From 24.11.2023 05:00

item.title: ARTE 360° Reportage - Nopal: Mexico's Green Gold (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (30.09.2023)
item.description:
The nopal cactus or prickly pear is the emblem of Mexico and is omnipresent in the country's cuisine. It grows in tight rows on the slopes of Milpa Alta, on the outskirts of Mexico City. Its medicinal properties are well known, now it is ready to conquer the world as a superfood
From 30.09.2023 05:00

item.title: The Ballarò Market - The Belly of Palermo (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (22.11.2023)
item.description:
A five stop culinary tour around Europe’s celebrated markets. In this episode: Palermo’s Ballarò market’s varied street food as well as the recipe for “cassata”. 
From 22.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Markets, Canals and Delicious Food - The Belly of Amsterdam (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (19.11.2023)
item.description:
A five stop culinary tour around Europe’s celebrated markets. In this episode: Markets are central to Amsterdam life. Albert Cuypmarkt which runs for 2.5 km in the working-class district of De Pijp is one of the oldest and most famous. 
From 19.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - Pelagos: Marine Mammal Sanctuary (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)
item.description:
Covering an area of 87,500 square kilometres, the Pelagos sanctuary was created specifically to protect large marine mammals. Many species such as dolphins, whales, rorquals, and sperm whales feed and reproduce in this maritime area, which stretches from France to Italy and surrounds Corsica.
From 08.09.2023 05:01

item.title: Europe's Wild Heart - The Life and Times of a Scots Pine Tree (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (18.10.2023)
item.description:
Indestructible, strong, and proud, the Scots pine is a national symbol of Scotland. The tree represents the rich history and inexhaustible vitality of the country and provides hope for the future. On the edge of Europe, the Scottish pine defies the unpredictable climate and forms the core of a fascinating ecosystem.
From 18.10.2023 12:30

item.title: The Rialto Market of Venice (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (23.11.2023)
item.description:
Venice’s Rialto market is the centre of the city’s culinary traditions. Here Venetians purchase fantastic seafood from the Venice lagoon as well as fruit and vegetables coming from the market garden islands surrounding the Queen of the Adriatic.
From 23.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - The Island of Port-Cros (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)
item.description:
Just off the coast from the French Riviera, Port-Cros is the smallest of the Hyères islands. Since 1963, its 7 square kilometres have formed the heart of Europe's oldest national park on both land and sea. In this living laboratory, conservationists and researchers from all over the world come to study this spectacular untouched ecosystems.
From 08.09.2023 05:01

item.title: The Ribeira Market - The Belly Of Lisbon (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (20.11.2023)
item.description:
A five stop culinary tour around Europe’s celebrated markets. In this episode: Lisbon’s largest market, the Ribeira, sells local produce from the sea and the land. Seafood, lemons, custard tarts and the Alentejo region's celebrated hams...
From 20.11.2023 05:00

item.title: The Parliament of Animals - Animal Democracies (2/2) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.11.2023)
item.description:
In Europe, animals in Greece may have been voting for far longer than people. Scientists discovered ten years ago that these species, each in their own way, have systems for making group decisions. This suffrage - more universal than we thought - helps the survival of the group.
From 17.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Group Decisions - Democracy in the Animal Kingdom (1/2) (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (17.11.2023)
item.description:
What if the Greeks hadn't invented democracy? This is a two-part documentary about animal species that make decisions collectively. In this first episode: on the African continent, in many animal societies, the leader consults the members of his or her group before making a decision. This discovery calls into question our beliefs about the animal world, which aren't governed by "law of the jungle".....
From 17.11.2023 05:00

item.title: La Palma - After the Eruption (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (09.09.2023)
item.description:
On 19 September 2021, the Cumbre Vieja volcano on the Spanish island of La Palma in the Canary Islands erupted. This spectactular and unexpected eruption was the largest in the last 500 years and a unique opportunity for scientists to study volcanic activity.
From 09.09.2023 05:00

item.title: Fragile and Beautiful Mediterranean - The Strait of Messina (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (08.09.2023)
item.description:
The waters of the Strait of Messina, which separates the Italian peninsula from Sicily, are virtually unexplored due to the powerful currents generated by the meeting of the Ionian and Tyrrhenian Seas, currents which also supports an exceptional biodiversity.
From 08.09.2023 05:01

item.title: The Viktualienmarkt - The Belly of Munich (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (21.11.2023)
item.description:
A five stop culinary tour around Europe’s celebrated markets. In this episode: Munich’s famous Viktualienmarkt hosts gourmet cheese stalls, beer gardens and much more…
From 21.11.2023 05:00

item.title: Medicines of the World - Air Care in Australia (Originalversion mit Untertitel) (14.11.2023)
item.description:
The Australian rural outback is notoriously dangerous and difficult to reach. As the saying goes: "Anything can kill you in Australia!" And so if anything goes wrong several hours away from civilisation, emergency help must come by air.
